instruction: Initiate returns via FedEx for everything in my last 2 amazon order.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The two most recent orders are modeled as order-last-1/order-last-2 (static recent-order facts); their line items are unknown at runtime so a representative two items per order is modeled via static (item-of order product quantity) facts; the real agent loops over every order_item returned by show_order and calls initiate_return once per (order, product) with the item's full quantity and FedEx's deliverer_id. show_orders reveals the order ids (orders-listed), show_order reveals the items of an order (known-items), show_return_deliverers reveals FedEx's id (deliverers-listed). supervisor-complete-task takes the returned order/product records as non-API parameters so its precondition is exactly the ground goal (all returns initiated); it is called with no answer. The gmail/file_system changes in the evaluation are automatic side effects of initiate_return (return labels/receipts), not agent actions.

plan: (supervisor-complete-task order-last-1 order-last-2 product-1a product-1b product-2a product-2b)
